title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.40541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling. We show that current benchmarks conflate predictor quality with task hardness: when the target model, dataset, or sampling configuration changes, reported accuracy collapses even though the predictor is unchanged. We trace this instability to an overlooked error source---the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding---and derive bounds that every prefill-side method must obey. Our analysis treats decoding as a stopped stochastic process. translated_title: 论预填充阶段解码长度预测的基本极限
translated_abstract: 仅利用预填充阶段的隐藏状态来预测大型语言模型（LLM）将解码多少个 token，是推理调度中的一个关键基础操作。我们表明，当前的基准测试将预测器质量与任务难度混为一谈：当目标模型、数据集或采样配置发生变化时，即使预测器本身保持不变，所报告的准确率也会大幅下降。我们将这种不稳定性追溯到一个被忽视的误差来源，自回归解码固有的随机性，并推导出所有基于预填充侧的方法都必须服从的界限。我们的分析将解码视为一个停时随机过程。响应的每步停止概率并非恒定，而是在数百步内逐渐上升，因此解码长度从决定响应在何处结束的众多局部决策中继承了中心极限定理；这带来了带有显式误差项的逐提示正态性，以及一个仿射方差律 σ=αμ+b，其……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了解码长度预测存在不可消除的根本极限——自回归解码的固有随机性（解码长度作为停时随机过程服从中心极限定理及仿射方差律 σ=αμ+b）决定了任何预填充侧方法的性能上界，而当前基准测试因混淆预测器质量与任务难度而失真。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the fundamental limits of prefill-based decoding length prediction: the inherent stochasticity of autoregressive decoding—where decode length, as a stopped stochastic process, obeys a central limit theorem and an affine variance law σ=αμ+b—bounds the performance of any prefill-side method, and current benchmarks are misleading because they conflate predictor quality with task hardness.
